# Scan the parquet file lazily with polars backend
lf = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet", backend="polars")

# Filter where status equals "ok", select user and duration columns, then collect

    lf
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select("user", "duration")
    .collect()
)
